caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile pattern in predominantly dark blue and white colors. The central field is filled with a repeating pattern of large floral medallions, each composed of intricate stylized flowers and foliage, arranged in rows and columns. Smaller floral motifs and star-like shapes fill the spaces between the medallions. The border features alternating motifs: in the corners, there are stylized structures resembling buildings or monuments; along the sides, there are eagle-like birds facing columns, with leafy branches below their wings. In the upper and lower borders, there are white-on-blue text sections in all capital letters; for example, the lower border reads "AGRICULTURE & MANUFACTURES ARE THE FOUNDATION OF OUR INDEPENDENCE JULY 4, 1831." The overall composition is symmetrical and geometric, with repeated motifs and patterned details framed by a narrow white edge.
title: Woven Bedspread
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
